The Warty Pig

The warty pig (Sus philippensis) is a wild swine native to the Philippines, recognized by the distinctive facial marks found on males. Primarily inhabiting forests and grasslands on Luzon and nearby islands, it plays an important ecological role by dispersing seeds and disturbing soil while foraging. Classified as Vulnerable, the species faces growing threats from habitat loss, hunting, and hybridization with domestic pigs. Protecting remaining forests is essential to its survival.
